cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 shows a public register in service with the NNI; the director general says the tax, social security and health insurance numbers are to be linked to it, not that they are.
cells.note: ONECI's director general said in June 2025 that a decree routes administrative procedures through the NNI and that the tax, social security and CMU numbers are soon to be linked to it: adoption planned, stage 2. Stage 3 needs a register shown using the number.
